patch:
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 ---
 name: PR-reviewer
-description: Reviews ONE open pull request on NeoTech/Camcraft (usually a third-party PR from a fork) against AGENTS.md - trial-merges it with current main and runs the touched suites and clippy, on the self-hosted Linux runner (pr-test.yml) when one is online, else in its own worktree, checks the project laws, posts the result as a plain review COMMENT and sets the PR's review label (merge-ready / needs-rework / conflicts / needs-maintainer). Never approves, never merges, never pushes; the maintainer approves and merges by hand.
+description: Reviews ONE open pull request on NeoTech/Camcraft (usually a third-party PR from a fork) against AGENTS.md - trial-merges it with current main and runs the touched suites and clippy, on a self-hosted runner (pr-test.yml) when one is online, else in its own worktree, checks the project laws, posts the result as a plain review COMMENT and sets the PR's review label (merge-ready / needs-rework / conflicts / needs-maintainer). Never approves, never merges, never pushes; the maintainer approves and merges by hand.
 model: sonnet
 ---
 
@@ -73,7 +73,7 @@ merge.
    diff with `git fetch origin pull/<N>/head:pr-<N>-review` and
    `git show pr-<N>-review:<path>`; no worktree is needed for reading.
 2b. **Where to build: the runner or here** (#1420; maintainer, 2026-11-13:
-   `workflow_dispatch` only, self-hosted Linux, started after the diff is
+   `workflow_dispatch` only, self-hosted (Linux or macOS), started after the diff is
    read). Use the runner only when all hold, else go to step 3 (local):
    - the PR's author is a collaborator with push access (`gh api
      repos/NeoTech/Camcraft/collaborators/<login>/permission --jq .permission`
@@ -85,8 +85,8 @@ merge.
      `.cargo/` directory at any depth, or `xtask/`. One of those is "read,
      not built" (Hard rules; no runner run), except an `xtask/`-only
      change, which is built locally (step 3);
-   - a self-hosted Linux runner is online:
-     `gh api repos/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runners --jq '[.runners[] | select(.status=="online") | select([.labels[].name|ascii_downcase] | index("self-hosted") and index("linux"))] | length'`
+   - a self-hosted runner with the `camcraft-pr-test` label is online:
+     `gh api repos/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runners --jq '[.runners[] | select(.status=="online") | select([.labels[].name|ascii_downcase] | index("self-hosted") and index("camcraft-pr-test"))] | length'`
      prints more than 0 (an error - a 403 for a token without admin read -
      counts as none online);
    - no cut is running on it: `gh run list --workflow cut.yml --json status
@@ -117,7 +117,7 @@ merge.
       that suite locally before calling it a blocker. `cancelled`,
       `timed_out` or any other conclusion is no verdict: build locally
       (step 3), or say "not built" - never a pass.
-   4. Linux does not check Windows-only readings. If the diff adds or
+   4. The runner checks only its own OS's arm of Windows-only readings. If the diff adds or
       changes a `cfg(windows)`, `cfg(target_os = ...)` or `cfg!(windows)`
       line or a per-OS pinned value (issue 1402), also run the touched
       suites locally (steps 3-4, those binaries only).

@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 ---
 name: review-prs
-description: Find open pull requests on NeoTech/Camcraft that need a review (third-party PRs from forks, or any PR whose current head has not been reviewed yet) and dispatch the PR-reviewer agent on each, one at a time (it builds on the self-hosted Linux runner through pr-test.yml when one is online, else locally). Posts review COMMENTS only - never approves or merges. Use when asked to "review the PRs", "check for new pull requests", "review PR #N", or from the periodic loop (`/loop 10m /review-prs`).
+description: Find open pull requests on NeoTech/Camcraft that need a review (third-party PRs from forks, or any PR whose current head has not been reviewed yet) and dispatch the PR-reviewer agent on each, one at a time (it builds on the self-hosted runner through pr-test.yml when one is online, else locally). Posts review COMMENTS only - never approves or merges. Use when asked to "review the PRs", "check for new pull requests", "review PR #N", or from the periodic loop (`/loop 10m /review-prs`).
 ---
 
 # Review open pull requests
@@ -95,7 +95,7 @@ takes the next. Never launch two `PR-reviewer` agents at once.
 **Build on the runner when one is online** (#1420; maintainer, 2026-11-13:
 "then that is the decision, workflow_dispatch"). The agent, not this skill,
 decides where the PR is built, because the decision needs the diff it reads
-(PR-reviewer step 2b): with a self-hosted Linux runner online, no cut on it,
+(PR-reviewer step 2b): with a self-hosted `camcraft-pr-test` runner online, no cut on it,
 a PR written by a collaborator with push access ("Collaborators only"; the
 workflow refuses any other author, which builds locally) and a PR that is
 not "read, not built", it starts `pr-test.yml`

@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 # PR test (#1420): the build-and-test step of a PR review, run on the
-# self-hosted Linux runner instead of a worktree on the reviewer's machine.
+# self-hosted runner (Linux or macOS) instead of a worktree on the reviewer's machine.
 # Started only by the PR-reviewer agent of a collaborator's session, after it
 # has read the diff (`.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md` step 2b):
 #   gh workflow run pr-test.yml -f pr=<N> -f sha=<head sha the reviewer read>
@@ -21,6 +21,9 @@
 # "Separate runner/user" - the job targets the runner label camcraft-pr-test,
 # an OS user of its own with its own HOME, never the cut/release runner
 # (issue 1413); cargo home and sccache are under that runner's work dir.
+# Any runner carrying camcraft-pr-test takes the job, whatever its OS: the
+# steps are bash 3.2 / BSD-tool safe, and on macOS the UI suites open real
+# windows, so that runner needs a logged-in session.
 # Provenance: our own review and gate laws (AGENTS.md "Outside PRs are
 # reviewed", "Three gate tiers"); GitHub's public Actions documentation for
 # the workflow syntax.
@@ -55,7 +58,7 @@ env:
 
 jobs:
   test:
-    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, camcraft-pr-test]
+    runs-on: [self-hosted, camcraft-pr-test]
     timeout-minutes: 90
     permissions:
       contents: read

@@ -839,7 +839,7 @@ holds `issues: write`.
 
 **The PR test runner** (#1420; maintainer, 2026-11-13: "then that is the
 decision, workflow_dispatch"). `pr-test.yml` runs a PR review's build and
-tests on the maintainer's self-hosted Linux runner (no billed minutes)
+tests on the maintainer's self-hosted runners (no billed minutes)
 instead of a 10-20 GB worktree on the reviewer's machine. It has a
 `workflow_dispatch` trigger only (inputs: the PR number and the head SHA
 the reviewer read), a read-only token and no secrets; it checks out
@@ -855,7 +855,10 @@ the workflow checks the author's push access itself and refuses otherwise,
 other PRs build locally) when a runner is online and no cut is using it; a "read, not built" PR
 is never sent. With no runner, or a run that is cancelled, times out or
 never starts, the review builds locally or says "not built" - never "pass".
-The job targets its own runner label (`camcraft-pr-test`) under its own OS
+The job targets the runner label `camcraft-pr-test` and runs on any self-hosted
+runner carrying it, Linux (`uma`) or macOS (`m3`); on macOS the UI suites open
+real windows, so that runner needs a logged-in session, and per-OS pinned
+readings run that OS's arm. Each runs under its own OS
 user, HOME, cargo home and sccache dir, never shared with the cut/release
 runner of issue 1413 ("Separate runner/user", same date). The refusal list
 does not stop hostile test code: that is why only collaborators' PRs run.
